component.source: Literal source component: (DL)-alpha-Lipoic acid, 50 mg per source batch, in DSMZ MediaDive solution 5980 (https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/solution/5980). Issue 1227 peer correction VM1227-PEER-001: exact racemic identity is CHEBI:748116 (lipoic acid, alpha), whose primary ChEBI release 255 statements include DL synonyms and a direct superclass CHEBI:60911 (racemate, an equimolar enantiomer mixture). It is distinct from the generic parent CHEBI:16494. TCI L0058 (https://www.tcichemicals.com/US/en/p/L0058) independently corroborates the explicit DL name and CAS1077-28-7 but does not establish DSMZ procurement. No active local owner holds CHEBI:748116, so EXTERNAL_TERM is deliberate. Literal amount, source preparation and all holds remain; no generic lipoic-acid components or owner roles are changed.
